label: Did the participant fall over straight away whilst doing the balance test with eyes open? - at age 77 years
meta_rows: Did the participant fall over straight away whilst doing the balance test with eyes open? - at age 77 years
Physical perfomance balance and co-ordination module.
cat_rows: During the clinic (or home) visit at age 60-64 years study participants were asked by the attending nurse whether they would be willing to perform tests of standing balance.  If willing and able (reasons for inability included health reasons and equipment not available) two tests of standing balance were performed, one with eyes open and one with eyes closed.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
